reviews.text: I had the best experience at this clinic. They worked within the budget that I had to make sure that I got the best possible care for my little dog. I know it sounds weird. We had to talk about price, but times are hard out here, but I wanted to get the best care possible for my pet. I feel the staff went above and beyond to help me. And I will definitely be going back because I think they really care.
Metro paws for the win. Perfect clinic all the way around.
This place was excellent and very endearing when we had to put our sweet Chester down. They gave us plenty of time to say goodbye with absolutely no rush.
Not only do I take my pets here for their checkups, I also board them here. My pets love it here!

My dearest Luna Tuna Denise had to have emergency surgery in having her kidney removed! This was a total surprise and devastating moment in our lives, but Dr. Clark Treasure and the rest of the team provided so much love and attention and TLC for My Baby. She is two weeks post surgery and showing great progress!!! Thank you so much Metro Paws in saving My Baby‘s life.
Metro Paws is awesome. Step is awesome. Very awesome. Great customer service and they care for our babies like if they were their babies. Thank you so much for all you do for my pepper and my junior.
If you are looking for a vet that cares. Check out this place they are wonderful! Definitely recommend.

Thank you for the 5 stars, Ileana. We’re glad your visit went smoothly and appreciate you taking a moment to leave a review. Don't hesitate to reach out if you have additional feedback or need anything.

I've taken my two cats here and the staff is really nice and knowledgable and give great service, they obviously love their patients, I just wish they were more transparent with their pricing, I don't like when I ask for them to check something and they nickel and dime me on every thing they look at and then the bill is way more than I was expecting. I get it bills need to be paid but damn, I'm just trying to take care of my babies.

Huge thank you to Metro Paws for staying late during an urgent late-night emergency with my cat! The entire staff was incredibly gentle, attentive, and reassuring. Top-tier patient experience when we needed it most—truly outstanding care.
Great people great job
Great staff always clean. Chopper loves going to see them.

Great first experience here. Kind, patient staff and the facility was very clean. There was a bit of a wait but I expect that and never felt rushed once it was our turn. They are transparent with their pricing as well. I appreciated getting everything listed up front before I consented to any treatments.

My dog had a lump appear on her foot and I was unable to see my vet so I called Metro Paws in Oakcliff. They were able to get her in same day with no extra fees. Cady and Dr. Breckyn examined my girl and they were very kind and compassionate. My dog was nervous and they went to extra lengths to calm her and make her feel comfortable. I was more nervous than her and they both did the same for me. LOL They ended up prescribing her two medications and a follow up to check on her in two weeks. This same day visit, Dr check and medications only cost me $132.
I recommend them and will be returning.

Great place ..happy people
.I like them..my dog does not.
It was very prompt with their service. Took care of our baby and everyone had a great attitude.

Dr. Rodriguez and the MPAH staff are so kind, generous, and amazing! Despite it being an emergency, they made me and my puppy feel as comfortable as possible and ensured we got seen at a speedy rate. This will now become my doggos vet home!
This companies employees lead with empathy, and it shine like a bright light.
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly.
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful for the opportunity to care for your pet. We look forward to seeing you again in the future!

I spoke with you directly regarding your concerns, and I appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback with me.

Please know that providing timely, compassionate care is very important to our team, and we are actively working on improving both phone accessibility and appointment flow to better serve our clients and patients.

We appreciate the opportunity to care for Oso and value your feedback as we continue to improve our services.

Update- Removing another star because a vet making sarcastic remarks in response to a review is crazy!

I boarded my dog here for a week because my dog had stitches that needed to be removed while I was out of town, and I will NEVER do it again!

They never called to give me any updates. They only provided two text updates during her entire stay, only when I texted them first. Not only that, but the texts from staff gave conflicting information… first person told me the stitches were out and the second person told me the stitches were still in. This is extremely concerning as this is not a regular boarding facility, this is a vet!! Staff told me on three separate occasions that they would send pictures of my dog, yet they NEVER did. I understand the practice being busy, but don’t even offer to send photos if you aren’t going to. It felt like pulling teeth just to get a basic update.

Upon checkout, they were about to process payment STILL without providing any medical updates, no mention of the suture removal. I ultimately had to physically check my dog myself in the lobby to confirm whether her stitches had actually been removed. This is inexcusable.

Don’t board your dog here unless you want a place that’s going to do the absolute bare minimum.

Love this place. Everyone is always so kind and gentle with my fur babies and fur grandbabies. Explanations are always understamdable. And I love how they give you a print out of what your expenses are so you are able to choose which treatment youd like.  Definately recommend

To the Amazing Team at Metro Paws Animal Hospital – Oak Cliff,

On behalf of our entire family, we want to express our deepest gratitude for the beautiful card, thoughtful messages, paw prints, nose print, and the Rainbow Bridge poem you sent in memory of our beloved Lola.

When we opened your letter, it brought tears to our eyes. In one of the most difficult moments our family has faced, your kindness, compassion, and heartfelt words reminded us that Lola was cared for not only as a patient, but as a member of a family. Every handwritten note, every prayer, every message of sympathy, and every person who took the time to sign the card meant more to us than words can truly express.

Lola was deeply loved and brought so much joy, loyalty, comfort, and happiness into our lives. The paw prints and nose print are treasures that we will cherish forever. They are a beautiful reminder that although she is no longer physically with us, her love and spirit will always remain in our hearts.

Please extend our sincere thanks to every doctor, technician, assistant, and staff member who cared for Lola and who took a moment out of their day to write a message for our family. Your compassion is a reflection of the incredible people you are and the special work you do every day.

We know Lola would have been wagging her tail and giving each of you kisses for the love and care you showed her throughout her time in need. We are thankful, and we believe she would be thankful too.

From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for treating Lola with dignity, kindness, and love, and for helping our family through this difficult time. Your support brought comfort when we needed it most, and we will never forget it.

With heartfelt appreciation and gratitude,

Villegas Family & in loving memory of Lola 🐾❤️

“Some companions leave paw prints on the floor, but the very best leave paw prints on our hearts forever.”

Great staff, clean facility and it’s a well-operated business. Not sure if it’s private equity profiteering or lack of common sense but recommended an x-ray for a puncture wound that never bled (tissue intact) to rule out if a bone was broken from superficial trauma. Charged $5.31 PER PILL for branded antibiotic when generic amoxicillin/clavulanate could be dispensed for literally cents.  They offered me a quote but I agreed without thinking they would scam me.  I hope the quick hit was worth losing my business.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!
We’re so happy to hear you had an enjoyable experience with us! We look forward to seeing you and your pet again!
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly.

I am writing this review with the heaviest of hearts, but I wanted to share our experience for anyone in the animal-loving community who may one day need exceptional veterinary care.

Although we did not get the happy ending we prayed for, the level of compassion, professionalism, education, and support we received from Metro Paws was truly extraordinary. During one of the most difficult moments of our lives, your team guided us with empathy, honesty, and genuine care every step of the way.

To the doctors, technicians, and staff — thank you. Every single visit, we were welcomed by one of the kindest, most knowledgeable, and most compassionate teams we have ever encountered. The clinic was always clean, organized, and calm, even during emotionally overwhelming moments. You never made us feel rushed, and you always took the time to explain everything with patience and understanding.

I know veterinary medicine is one of the hardest professions, and this experience gave us an even deeper respect for the people who dedicate their lives to caring for animals and supporting families through heartbreak and uncertainty.

While we may not have gotten the outcome we hoped for, I will forever be grateful that Metro Paws was there to help us navigate this journey with dignity, compassion, and care. Thank you for loving animals the way you do and for being there for families when they need it most.

#Mr.President
Friendly and professional service.

I chose this location for our vet because it’s so close to home. It’s so convenient to have a 5 minute drive but sometimes they have you waiting 45+ minutes after your appointment to see the vet. Very frustrating. What’s the point of an appointment?

Terrible service. I took my cat in for a dog bite. They were quick, yes! But they were only interested in getting money out of me. As soon as they saw him, they did things to my cat without my consent. They tried to charge me for things I never agreed to, and after that, the "doctor" insisted about five times that the only option was to euthanize my cat. What kind of professionalism is this? As a doctor, she should have prioritized the cat's life, not suggested killing him. After charging me about $350 for absolutely nothing—just an injection—I took him to another place where they said he would be fine and gave him proper care, and I paid less.

We already loved coming to MetroPaws for our cats regular check-ups and care due to the kindness and professionalism of the staff and our vet Dr. Bixby. But after one of our kittens developed mysterious lumps and ultimately got diagnosed with rare parasitic disease leishmaniasis, I can confidently say that the veterinary expertise and care at MetroPaws is unmatched.

Dr. Bixby has been such a massive help and support in this process - he has put an insane amount of research, care, and time into figuring out the best treatment plan for her. He has kept us informed every step of the way, and has approached such a scary and upsetting time in our lives with unmatched empathy.
Our journey with treating our kittens disease is far from over, but I am so overwhelmingly grateful to have such a wonderful veterinary team in our corner.

Thank you all so much!

My dog needed surgery and after getting a hernia and we called everywhere they either quoted us $4-6k with no payment plans then we got recommended to metro paws in oak cliff and we came in for a consultation, Amazing employees they are so sweet and after the consultation we quickly got an appointment for his surgery we got quoted 1k but it came with payment plans my dog was also getting neutered with the hernia surgery. Dr. Rodriguez was teddys doctor and I can’t to express how amazing she was, after the surgery she kept checking up on teddy and unfortunately he kept getting complications after the surgery, but Dr. Rodriguez was always there to check on him till he got better. After this experience I truly felt so grateful for all of the employees there I will definitely be coming back for anything else that concerns my dogs!
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

I cannot express enough gratitude to the team at MetroPaws Oak Cliff. We recently had to say goodbye to our 15-year-old rescue, Grumbles, and the grace, empathy, and professionalism we experienced here were unlike anything I’ve ever seen.

Our journey started late on a Friday evening. Grumbles was bloated and uncomfortable; we arrived at 7:30 PM, just 30 minutes before closing. Instead of rushing us out, Dr. Lavender and the vet techs met us with total kindness. They prioritized his well-being over a ticking clock, providing an honest assessment and guidance for overnight care without even asking for payment (and not even knowing if we would return to them or another clinic!).

When my husband brought him back Saturday, Dr. Hanks spent hours with him. They discovered significant fluid (ascites) and were incredibly honest about the limitations of the testing. Most importantly, they truly listened when we explained that we prioritized his comfort over longevity taking his age into consideration.

Grumbles was a survivor the world had largely given up on. Long before he found us, he had been failed by previous owners and labeled by Dallas Animal Services. When we found him abandoned at a Greenville Avenue gas station, he was already a senior of 8 or 10 years. He had spent two days evading everyone trying to catch him, but for some reason, he felt an instant connection with my husband and jumped right into his car the moment the door opened.

When we took him to DAS to scan for a chip, we were met with a heartbreaking reality: because of a bite history from when he was just a puppy, nearly a decade earlier, the shelter told us he would have to be euthanized if we left him there. When we finally tracked down his previous owners, they simply admitted they didn't want him anymore. We refused to let his story end that way. We brought him home just one week before the historic Texas freeze; he never would have survived that winter, or that system, if we hadn't stepped in.

MetroPaws honored that history. They didn't see a "bite-history dog" or a discarded senior; they saw the gentle guardian we loved. They treated him with the dignity he deserved after a lifetime of overcoming the odds, ensuring a dog who started with nothing ended his life feeling like the most important boy in the world.

What truly sets this clinic apart is their humanity. We are currently facing financial duress between paychecks, yet the staff never once made us feel "less than." They worked with us so Grumbles could get immediate care. When we returned on Monday for end-of-life care, Dr. Hanks was incredibly patient with my grief-ridden self, performing one last check-up to reassure me we were doing the right thing.

They even offered to waive the euthanasia fee and helped us arrange his final care knowing we had to wait until payday for payment. To see a vet tech get teary-eyed with us, and to hear Dr. Hanks whisper to Grumbles to "sleep sweetly" and that he was a "good boy" as he passed... it was a moment of pure, raw compassion. These folks weren't just doing a job; they were escorting a sweet soul to his rest.

My history with MetroPaws goes back years. As a teacher for students with significant cognitive disabilities in Oak Cliff, I once reached out for a vocational speaker. They connected me with their White Rock location, where a vet and tech did a Zoom call with my class while in surgery. It was an unforgettable experience for my students.

Our primary vet of many years recently retired, and finding a new "home" has been difficult.

Even though MetroPaws knew they weren't our primary clinic, they never pressured us or made us feel like a transaction. They simply stepped up when we needed them most.

Dr. Lavender, Dr. Hanks, and their incredible vet techs have earned our loyalty for life.

Thank you for making the hardest day of our lives a little more bearable.

The world needs more community members like y'all.

I am so grateful that I found Metro Paws when I did.  My first experience with them was my dog having to have surgery.  They were patient with all of my questions. They were very gentle and good with my dog.  There follow up was great.  I recommend them highly.
I go to Metro Paws for all of my pets needs they are super attentive very sweet people and all of my pets love them and there's never anything that they cannot help with

Updated review 4/8/2026
I unfortunately had to update my previous positive review. After my initial appointment I had to return a week later due to my pet’s condition worsening. I was given another prescription very similar to the first and was told to continue waiting it out.

It has now been almost 2 weeks from that appointment and my pet’s condition has not improved despite following all directions.

I am hesitant to return a third time and pay $150+ for the third time to be told to wait it out again. My two initial appointments consisted of a quick 10 mins exam with the vet and I was on my way. Slightly upset more wasn’t done looking back now.

Overall- the staff are all nice and welcoming (Dr. Castillo seemed to take my concerns seriously and was so knowledgeable on my 2nd visit back, thank you!) but I cannot justify the prices for a quick exam and almost exact medicine prescriptions given on both occasions with no results.

Original review: Everyone was so sweet! I took my cat in and they were responsive and welcoming since the scheduling phone call. Even after the appointment they have followed up!

Service was excellent, choose location because it's close to home. Just found it somewhat expensive for overall service which was around $300 just for pet check up, a dog shampoo & flea treatment for two dogs, I'll definitely won't be coming back.
They recommend a shampoo for my dogs skin & I found the same one online $13 cheaper &  also found it at a bigger size than what I received for only $3 more than what I was charged for on my visit.
Also, a few mistakes were made  they gave me some oral chew tablet flea/tick treatment for both dogs but they got it switched around at first, they gave me the bigger size one for the smaller dog & vice-versa if it wasn't for Jessica the technician who noticed it,maybe I wouldn' have & that might have been dangerous & at the end of my visit  they forgot to give me back all of my dog's documents which I brought in since it was my first visit, I had to go back & remind them to return them.
10/10 experience

I truly can’t say enough amazing things about Metro Paws Oak Cliff. They quite literally saved my dog’s life, and I will be forever grateful for their team.

From the moment I walked in, the staff showed so much compassion, urgency, and professionalism. They took the time to explain everything clearly, kept me informed throughout the process, and treated my dog with incredible care and kindness.

You can tell they genuinely love what they do and deeply care about every animal that comes through their doors. In a stressful and emotional situation, they gave me peace of mind and hope—and the outcome was more than I could have asked for.

Thank you, Metro Paws, for going above and beyond. You have earned a lifelong client and my highest recommendation to anyone looking for a veterinary team they can truly trust.
Awesome service
The staff is so friendly and makes everything really easy when it comes to booking and coming in for a visit. Plus, their hours are great. My pet got in same day for a visit and X-ray!
Fantastic , responsive, communicative and caring staff. Wonderful experience when my little guy was sick !

Be very careful when you go to this place. Prices always change. They are very dishonest and only try to get as much money out of you as possible. Once they charged me one amount for a certificate, I went back a month later and they wanted to charge me triple. I don't recommend them; there are many better and cheaper places.

Be very careful when you go to this place. Prices always change. They are very dishonest and only try to get as much money out of you as possible. Once they charged me one amount for a certificate, I went back a month later and they wanted to charge me triple. I don't recommend them; there are many better and cheaper places.

I took my dog ​​to the emergency vet for a bite on her eyelid, and to be honest, I don't have much money, but I didn't want her to heal alone or suffer. They treated her well, they speak Spanish, and I felt very confident. I'm very happy with their kindness; my dog ​​was happy with the staff, she's recovering, and they offer financing for when you can't pay everything at once.

I would recommend this place to anyone! They were able to get me a same day appointment for a stray cat that had an injured paw.  The tech, Bre, and the doctor, Bixby, were awesome and super diligent when it came to examining the cat. I did enjoy the fact they quoted me for the services before performing the services. Thank y'all so much for seeing us on short notice and the awesome service. I have decided to make an appointment soon to get the cat fully checked out as I hope to transition this cat into my house cat.

I am truly disappointed in the service of this veterinarian, truly if i could rate it a zero star I would. I left my pup for a surgery on Tuesday everything went according to plan until Friday when I took him again, and nobody at this vet informed me that they were going to take the sutures out of my dog. I thought it was only a check up and until today morning I noticed my pup had re-opend his wound. I quickly took him back to them and they informed me until today that on Friday his sutures were removed. I was completely in shock of the situation due to not being informed, it was truly unprofessional on their part. Not only that they charged me once more, for a mistake they did. Once again unprofessional. I can’t come to understand how an establishment with an over all rating 4.5 start could do this and worst of all they didn’t offer me no support. I would like to speak to the manager and the team in charge, because the people that were working there this week seems like they did not care enough.

Truly if you love your pet, do not give this vet a chance they will not care.

Great location for travel. All staff members were very informative with any and all information given to me and Dr. Spillers did a fantastic job with her examination! Overall a very pleasant experience.

Metro Paws was recommended to me by two people while my cat was ill. Within hours of the initial appointment she had to be euthanized, to no fault of the clinic, she was FeLV+. They were phenomenal. Everyone was so kind and so empathetic. Dr. Bixby was particularly helpful. Take it with no grain of salt, you  have to be a damn good vet to get a good review after an unexpected death.

The staff was so nice and kind to my baby girl! They did a great job of taking care of her and getting everything done. Definitely make sure to ask for all options for cost of meds because expensive options are presented first. Once asked, they did give me all options.
Excellent, attentive staff. Very professional in all aspects.

We noticed immediately when we walked in that great care is taken to keep the facility clean- it did not smell like animals at all. Everyone was friendly and let us know what to expect. Dr. Bixby was very thorough and spent enough time with us and our dog to do a thorough exam and answer all our questions. I especially liked that we were given a written quote before we decided how we wanted to proceed. We ended up going with everything he recommended because the prices were very reasonable. Very happy with our experience, and we feel our dog has gotten really good care here. I think Lucy actually enjoyed the visit too.

We’ve had such a wonderful experience with the Metro Paws Team. They took the time to answer all of my questions and were incredibly patient and helpful every step of the way. They truly went above and beyond to make sure Sadie and Dio received the best possible care, and to make sure I felt informed and comfortable as well. It’s so clear how much they genuinely care about their patients and their owners. I’m incredibly grateful for the care Sadie and Dio received and highly recommend this team to anyone looking for compassionate, thorough care.

We were seeing this vet for years and when we decided to move to another country, we consulted one of the vets who has a certificate to handle animal  transportation. It is a year-long process and we were told that we can not make any mistakes since one mistake could cost us whole paperworks to start over. Then, we found so many errors in the paperworks they worked on. First, the microchip number was wrong in their records and on the documents. Second, there were so many small errors about the name (kind) of vaccinations. They also made a mistake on the delivery method on the important document that need to be submitted to USDA. Of course, it cost us hundreds of dollars on every visit and it was impossible to talk to the vet on the phone. IF you are thinking about moving your animals to other countries, do not use this clinic.

Our cat Pepper needed somewhat urgent care & because metro paws was close by at the time, gave them a chance. Being anywhere else but home is extremely stressful for her. Well, metro paws is a great disappointment. We arrived at the time of our appointment and they didn’t have a room for us. Expecting us to wait in a lobby full of dogs. The staff response was in the vein of disregard. Making a stressful situation a traumatic one. The vet was generally informative but not worth the stress. This will be our last visit here.

My cat was hit by a car yesterday afternoon, the vet and staff were so kind even though he died just as I was walking in the door.  They took him back to see if they could save him and were so thoughtful and understanding when they told me there was nothing they could do!! It was heartbreaking but the staff eased the pain for those fifteen minutes 😿💔

My cat had some problems with his teeth and wasn’t able to eat at all
I’ll give em credit for being able to see my cat same day and give me a quote on how much it would cost for the dental surgery.
Nothing against the staff at all, matter of fact they were quite nice, there prices on the other hand was really high, just for the consultation and some meds to take home I paid close 400 bucks, the dental surgery was no less than 2 grand but the total might be close to 2600 bucks.
Of course I ended up going to a different vet, but even when I choose not to pay metro paws to perform the surgery, they were very nice and understanding, and when I asked for the blood results they performed, they sent it soon as it they got the results back and for that I say thank you.
Dr. Bixby and Bre were amazing! Super friendly and explained everything thoroughly.

The staff here has taken great care of our little girl.  Not only for her normal care, but also when she got Parvo they were so helpful and gave us everything we needed to make sure she got better.    They are a great vet and I would always recommend them.

I’m from out of town and they were able to immediately see my cat who was diagnosed with pancreatitis. They gave her amazing care, medication, and the attention she needed to get better. Ketamine Kitty picture attached because ‘she’s a tank’
Dr Spillers is the best Vet ever!  She saved my Zonny’s life and I’m forever grateful.
They always take such good care of my mom’s pets! Julissa Silva was helping us out, and she’s just so kind and doing a fantastic job, she’s so professional. Thanks a bunch!

I went here for my dog that was suffering from a chronic ear infection. The vet prescribed me an overpriced prescription diet and basically told me she couldn’t help my dog but suggested I go to a specialist and get her eardrum removed to solve the problem…a few months later I went to a different vet in Fort Worth turns out she just had a staff infection in her ear…this vet should be ashamed of herself and go back to school.

I didn't even step foot into this location. That's how amazing their customer service is. This isn't my regular vet but I discovered my dog had worms so called here because i was mildly panicking. Mario ((I hope this was his name!)) was so reassuring of the situation and I didn't feel he was trying to get me in to spend money. He really took my situation and panic into consideration and make it about the patient and pet. Not the money.

I will definitely be looking into this vet for potential future services but again, just on the customer service alone, i highly recommend!

Excellent location. I came here based off other recommendations and was not disappointed. They took excellent care of my sweet fur babies. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. I didn’t have any issues booking an appointment and the reception area is big enough if you have your animal(s) there is room for space. Make sure you have your animals in a carrier or on a leash as they won’t allow them inside if not. The vet techs were kind and had no issue explaining the medications my animals had to be on and they were very gentle with handling, especially on the scale. They will take the time with you and assist with any questions you may have. I will add that I found them costly, but maybe that was due to the entirety of the check up and medications.
